synthetic_read.scope: synthetic JSONL hashing, parsing and exact field checks only; no target data
synthetic_read.prediction_limitation: Does not measure actual target archive decoding, total bookkeeping, cold disk or source/authority IO.

measurements.synthetic_source_delta: Final source adds only original terminal plan/card/wrapper association and its output pins; measured comparison/arithmetic functions unchanged.

basis: Bounded finite saved-field audit; thresholds, ordinal choices and all expected datasets fixed before outcomes; prior producer summary exposure remains disclosed.
authority_contract: Each authority_assertions entry has role supervisor_closure or source_and_output_inventory, file pin {path,sha256,bytes}, and nonempty assertions [{pointer,equals}]. Original receipt is terminal closure.json. Populate only from actual closed evidence.
original_failure_policy: Refuse missing/failed original completion; preserve failure rather than create substitute success.
launch_requirements: Root review of exact source and concrete card
Actual original terminal and separate supervisor/source/output authority
All51 output pins and measured manifest bytes
Fresh capacity and exact external supervisor source/command review
